entry.name: mc.ezdac~
entry.description: mc.ezdac~ works as a user interface version of the mc.dac~ object. It appears as a button which can be clicked with the mouse to turn audio on or off.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Clicking ontoggles audio processing on or off. Audio on is represented by the object being highlighted.

messages.name: int
messages.description: A non-zero number turns on audio processing in all loaded patches.turns off audio processing in all loaded patches.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Set logical output channels for each signal channel
messages.description: comprised of integers, sets the logical output channels for each channel of a multichannel signal.

messages.name: local
messages.digest: Enable audio processing in local patch and subpatches only
messages.description: The word, followed by, makes a click to turn on anobject equivalent to sending it the. The messagereturns theobject to its default mode where a click to turn it on is equivalent to themessage.

messages.name: open
messages.description: Opens the Audio Status window. The window is also brought to the front.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set the output channel for first channel
messages.description: In any inlet: The word, followed by a number, sets the logical output channel for the first channel in a multichannel signal sent to.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: Audio in a multichannel signal coming intowill be sent to logical audio output channels 1 and 2. The signals must be between -1 and 1 to avoid clipping.

messages.name: start
messages.digest: Turn on audio processing in all loaded patches.
messages.description: Turns on audio processing in all loaded patches.

messages.name: startwindow
messages.digest: Enable audio processing in local patch and subpatches only
messages.description: Turns on audio processing only in the patch in which thisis located, and in subpatches of that patch. Turns off audio processing in all other patches.

messages.name: stop
messages.digest: Turns off audio processing in all loaded patches.
messages.description: Turns off audio processing in all loaded patches.
